newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian bourse lifts suspension on insurance firm.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian bourse lifts suspension on insurance firm.

text.p: Trading in shares of British-American Insurance Company (BAICO) resumed on Thursday after an almost two-month suspension, the Nigerian stock exchange said.
The exchange took the action on January 8 after its external auditors queried BAICO's accounts.
"The problem with the external auditors has been resolved," bourse official Lance Elakhama told dealers.
Another official said the exchange was satisfied with the way the matter was resolved, adding: "Otherwise, the suspension would not have been lifted."
No BAICO official was immediately available for comments.
BAICO shares traded unchanged on Thursday at 1.68 naira.
